svg.aria-label: India including the full territory depicted by the Government of India, using DataMeet’s open-licensed composite outline; neighbouring countries for context.
svg.title: India — official Indian boundary depiction
svg.desc: India outline: DataMeet CC0 composite, including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Arunachal Pradesh and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Lakshadweep coastline: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via DataMeet. Neighbouring context: Natural Earth. Educational map, not a government endorsement or a boundary survey.
